acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

Precursor ions were measured in a data-dependent mode in the orbitrap analyser scanning between 375-1200 m/z at a resolution of 120,000 and a Normalised AGC target of 300% (3e6 ions) (max. MS1 injection time set to “Auto”).

alkylation_concentration.evidence: 300 µg of protein was reduced with 5 mM tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride (Sigma C4706) at 37°C for 20 min and alkylated using 10 mM 2-chloroacetamide (Sigma 22790) for 20 min at room temperature protected from light.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Peptides were digested with Endoproteinase LysC for 3.5 h at 30°C, urea diluted to 1.5 M with 50 mM triethylammonium bicarbonate (Sigma T7408), followed by an overnight trypsin digestion at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: MS/MS scans were generated using HCD fragmentation with the collision energy set to 30%, and measured in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 15,000 and a Normalised AGC target of 100% (1e5 ions) (max. MS2 injection time set to “Auto”).

enrichment_method.evidence: Phosphopeptide enrichment was carried out using Ti-IMAC HP (MagReSyn #MR-THP005)) magnetic beads according to manufacturer protocol.

fragmentation_method.evidence: MS/MS scans were generated using HCD fragmentation with the collision energy set to 30%, and measured in the Orbitrap at a resolution of 15,000 and a Normalised AGC target of 100% (1e5 ions) (max. MS2 injection time set to “Auto”).

instrument.evidence: nanoLC-MS/MS was performed on a Orbitrap Exploris 480 coupled to a Easy-nLC 1200 (Thermo Scientific) liquid chromatograph.

ionization_type.evidence: Peptides were ionised by electrospray ionisation using 1.8 kV applied immediately prior to the analytical column via a microtee built into the nanospray source with the ion transfer tube heated to 320°C and the RF-lens set to 45%.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Label-free quantification in MaxQuant was used with a LFQ minimum ratio count of 2, Fast LFQ selected and the ‘skip normalisation’ option selected.
